In the race at Bellingham, Fletcher beat Hyde in convincing fashion, and our scratch team finished 1, 5, 6 and 7—most satisfactory. Redgrave was second in the individual handicap and was a member of our team placed second in the team handicap.

Meanwhile, Redgrave gave further evidence of his continued improvement and he is to be warmly congratulated upon gaining third place in the championship, which also earned for him second prize in the sealed handicap.

Speechley again showed that he is faster than ever, and Charlie Churcher and Redgrave also distinguished themselves. In fact, the performances of the three last-named, all "Juniors," were very encouraging, as were those of Rutland, already mentioned, and Storey.
Later in the year Harry won the HORWOOD CUP, with Redgrave second, Speechley third and Harley fourth----the first of many trophies he was to hold over the years.
